title: 迷路
description: 迷路時尋求幫助的用語

sentences.en: Excuse me, I'm lost.
Where am I right now?
Can you help me find my hotel?
sentences.zh: 你能幫我找到我的飯店嗎？

sentences.en: I can't find my way back.
Which direction is the train station?
I've been walking in circles.
Can you show me on the map?
sentences.zh: 你能在地圖上指給我看嗎？

sentences.en: How do I get to the main street?
I'm looking for this address.
Is this the right way to the airport?
sentences.zh: 這是去機場的正確方向嗎？

sentences.en: I took a wrong turn somewhere.
sentences.zh: 我在某個地方轉錯彎了。

sentences.en: My phone died and I can't use GPS.
sentences.zh: 我的手機沒電了，沒辦法用GPS。

sentences.en: Can you call a taxi for me?
I don't recognize this area.
How far is it from here?
I'm supposed to meet someone at this place.
sentences.zh: 我本來要在這個地方跟人碰面。

sentences.en: Can you point me to the nearest subway station?
sentences.zh: 你能指引我到最近的地鐵站嗎？

sentences.en: I got separated from my group.
Do you know where this street is?
sentences.zh: 你知道這條街在哪裡嗎？

sentences.en: I'm a tourist and I need directions.
Is there a landmark nearby I can use?
sentences.zh: 附近有什麼地標我可以參考嗎？

sentences.en: I was trying to find the museum.
Can you walk me to the bus stop?
sentences.zh: 你能帶我走到公車站嗎？

sentences.en: I think I'm on the wrong street.
Which bus goes to the city center?
I need to find my way to the embassy.
sentences.zh: 我需要找到去大使館的路。

sentences.en: Could you write down the directions for me?
sentences.zh: 你能把路線寫下來給我嗎？

sentences.en: I don't speak the local language well.
Is there a police station nearby where I can ask for help?
sentences.zh: 附近有警察局可以求助嗎？

sentences.en: I need to get back to my hotel before dark.
sentences.zh: 我需要在天黑前回到飯店。
